name: The Tome of Strahd
summary: A history of the devil, written in his own hand. Madam Eva says it holds the knowledge of his past.

stages.journal: Madam Eva's first card spoke of history: a book in the devil's own hand, which tells where he came from and what he lost. She saw where it lies. {tarokka.tome.hint}
stages.hint: Search where Madam Eva's card pointed: {tarokka.tome.hint}

stages.journal: We have the Tome of Strahd. The handwriting never wavers.
